source_id: BW-MMS-01 BW-MMS-01 Registration — Approved; CW-MMS-01 Registration Request Lifecycle
purpose: Verify the valid registration path and approval outcome.
preconditions: A student is eligible to submit a registration request.
No registration window is currently open.

steps: Mess Caretaker opens the registration window.
Student submits a valid request while the window is open.
Mess Caretaker approves the pending request.

test_data.window_information: Sufficient information to open the window, as required by the specification.

action_or_input.workflow_path: Registration Window Not Open -> Registration Window Open -> Registration Request Pending -> Registration Request Approved / Student Registered

expected_result: The window becomes open, the request becomes Pending, and approval results in Approved / Student Registered.
MMS records request history and triggers the student email notifications for submission and decision.

source_id: BW-MMS-02 BW-MMS-02 Registration — Rejected; CW-MMS-01 Registration Request Lifecycle
purpose: Verify the valid registration path when the Caretaker rejects the pending request.
preconditions: A registration window is open.
A valid student registration request can be submitted.

steps: Student submits a valid request while the registration window is open.
Mess Caretaker rejects the pending request.
action_or_input.workflow_path: Registration Window Not Open -> Registration Window Open -> Registration Request Pending -> Registration Request Rejected

expected_result: The request progresses to Pending and then Rejected; the student is not registered by this outcome.
MMS records request history and triggers the student email notifications for submission and decision.

source_id: BW-MMS-01 Registration Management — closed-window guard (Problem Statement)
purpose: Determine the result of a registration submission outside an open window.
preconditions: No registration window is open.

steps: Student attempts to submit a registration request.
action_or_input.workflow_path: Attempt registration submission while Registration Window is Not Open
action_or_input.blocked_reason: The guard is specified, but the expected system outcome on violation is not.

source_id: BW-MMS-03 BW-MMS-03 Deregistration — Approved; CW-MMS-02 Deregistration Request Lifecycle
purpose: Verify that approval is recorded immediately and service deregistration takes effect only when the next calendar day begins.
preconditions: The student is registered and active in mess service.

steps: Student submits a valid deregistration request.
Mess Caretaker approves it.
Check the student's service state before the next calendar day begins.
Allow the next calendar day to begin and check the service state again.

test_data.approval_time: A known calendar date and time.
test_data.activation_check: Check after approval on the same calendar day and again when the next calendar day begins.

action_or_input.workflow_path: Student Registered -> Deregistration Request Pending -> Deregistration Approved — Awaiting Effective Date -> Student Deregistered / Mess Service Inactive at the next calendar day

expected_result: The request becomes Pending and then Approved — Awaiting Effective Date.
The student remains registered until the next calendar day begins after approval.
At that trigger, the student becomes Deregistered and mess service becomes Inactive.
MMS triggers the student email notifications for request submission and decision.

source_id: BW-MMS-04 BW-MMS-04 Deregistration — Rejected; CW-MMS-02 Deregistration Request Lifecycle
purpose: Verify that rejecting a valid deregistration request leaves mess service active.
preconditions: The student is registered and active in mess service.

steps: Student submits a deregistration request.
Mess Caretaker rejects the pending request.
action_or_input.workflow_path: Student Registered -> Deregistration Request Pending -> Deregistration Request Rejected / Student remains Registered

expected_result: The request becomes Rejected and the student remains Registered.
MMS triggers the student email notifications for request submission and decision.

source_id: BW-MMS-05 BW-MMS-05 Rebate — Approved as Submitted; CW-MMS-03 Rebate Request Lifecycle
purpose: Verify valid rebate requests for all named reason categories and the minimum-duration and lead-time boundaries when approved without date changes.
preconditions: The student has no overlapping rebate request.
The caretaker can review the submitted request.

steps: Submit each valid rebate scenario.
For each resulting Pending request, have the Mess Caretaker approve without changing dates.

test_data.duration: Exactly 3 calendar days in each scenario.
test_data.lead_time: Request submitted one calendar day before the start date.
test_data.dates: Non-overlapping dates with complete reason/date data.

action_or_input.workflow_path: No Current Rebate Request -> Rebate Request Pending -> Rebate Approved without date modification

expected_result: Each valid submission becomes Pending.
Each approved request becomes Approved with submitted dates unchanged, and those approved dates are used for monthly billing adjustment.
MMS triggers student email notifications for each submission and decision.

source_id: BW-MMS-06 BW-MMS-06 Rebate — Dates Modified then Approved; CW-MMS-03 Rebate Request Lifecycle
purpose: Verify the date-modification-and-approval path and that the modified approved dates drive billing adjustment.
preconditions: A valid rebate request is Pending.

steps: Have Mess Caretaker modify the pending request dates and approve it, using a modification permitted by institution policy.

test_data.modified_dates: Not specifiable until the institution's policy-permitted modification rules are supplied.

action_or_input.workflow_path: Rebate Request Pending -> Caretaker modifies dates under permitted policy -> Rebate Approved with Modified Dates
action_or_input.blocked_reason: The workflow is conditional on external policy, whose permitted date changes are not specified.

source_id: BW-MMS-07 BW-MMS-07 Rebate — Rejected; CW-MMS-03 Rebate Request Lifecycle
purpose: Verify rejection of a valid rebate request.
preconditions: The student has no overlapping rebate request.

steps: Student submits the valid rebate request.
Mess Caretaker rejects it.
action_or_input.workflow_path: No Current Rebate Request -> Rebate Request Pending -> Rebate Rejected

expected_result: The request progresses to Pending and then Rejected.
No approval-based billing adjustment is applied for this rejected request.
MMS triggers student email notifications for submission and decision.

source_id: BW-MMS-05 Rebate Management — minimum-duration guard (Problem Statement)
purpose: Determine the outcome when a rebate request violates the minimum duration.
preconditions: The student has no overlapping rebate request.

steps: Student submits the rebate request.

test_data.other_fields: Complete, with at least one calendar day of lead time.

action_or_input.workflow_path: Attempt rebate submission with duration below 3 days
action_or_input.blocked_reason: Violation behavior is unspecified; asserting a rejection, error, or absence of record would invent behavior.

source_id: BW-MMS-05 Rebate Management — lead-time guard (Problem Statement)
purpose: Determine the outcome when a rebate request fails the stated submission lead time.

steps: Student submits the rebate request.

test_data.submission_date: Same calendar date as the rebate start date.

action_or_input.workflow_path: Attempt rebate submission less than one calendar day before its start date
action_or_input.blocked_reason: The specification provides no validation response or request-state behavior for an insufficient lead time.

source_id: BW-MMS-05 Rebate Management — overlapping-request guard (Problem Statement)
purpose: Determine the outcome when a rebate request overlaps an existing request.
preconditions: The student has an existing rebate request with known dates.

steps: Student submits the overlapping rebate request.
action_or_input.workflow_path: Attempt a rebate submission whose dates overlap another request for the same student
action_or_input.blocked_reason: The guard is known; the expected violation outcome is not.

source_id: BW-MMS-05 Rebate Management — mandatory explanation for other (Problem Statement)
purpose: Determine the outcome when the mandatory explanation for reason other is omitted.
preconditions: The student has no overlapping rebate request.

steps: Student submits the rebate request.
action_or_input.workflow_path: Attempt a rebate submission with reason other and no explanation
action_or_input.blocked_reason: The required field is stated without an expected validation result.

source_id: BW-MMS-08 BW-MMS-08 Vacation Survey — Yes Response; CW-MMS-04 Vacation Food Continuity Response Lifecycle
purpose: Verify survey creation, registered-student inclusion, and an explicit Yes response before the deadline.
preconditions: At least one student is currently registered and one student is not currently registered.
An upcoming institute vacation is identified.

steps: Mess Caretaker creates the vacation food continuity survey with a response deadline.
Inspect the survey recipient set.
The registered student responds Yes before the deadline.

test_data.response_deadline: A future deadline set by the Mess Caretaker.

action_or_input.workflow_path: Vacation Survey Not Created -> Vacation Survey Open -> Vacation Response = Yes

expected_result: The survey opens and includes currently registered students only; the unregistered student is not included.
The registered student's response is recorded as Yes.
MMS triggers the vacation survey creation email notification.

source_id: BW-MMS-09 BW-MMS-09 Vacation Survey — No Response; CW-MMS-04 Vacation Food Continuity Response Lifecycle
purpose: Verify that an explicit No response before the deadline is recorded as No.
preconditions: A vacation survey is open for a currently registered student.

steps: Student submits No before the response deadline.
action_or_input.workflow_path: Vacation Survey Not Created -> Vacation Survey Open -> Vacation Response = No

expected_result: The student's vacation response is recorded as No; it is not the system's default-No outcome.

source_id: BW-MMS-10 BW-MMS-10 Vacation Survey — Default No; CW-MMS-04 Vacation Food Continuity Response Lifecycle
purpose: Verify the system applies the specified default No for a non-responding student when the response deadline is reached.
preconditions: A vacation survey is open for a currently registered student.
The student has no recorded response.

steps: Allow the configured response deadline to be reached without a student response.
Inspect the student's recorded response.

test_data.response_deadline: A specific deadline configured by the Caretaker.

action_or_input.workflow_path: Vacation Survey Open -> response deadline reached without response -> Vacation Response = Default No

expected_result: The system records Vacation Response = Default No.

source_id: BW-MMS-08 Vacation Survey — response exactly at deadline
purpose: Determine whether an explicit response at the deadline is accepted or defaulted.
preconditions: A vacation survey is open and a registered student has not yet responded.

steps: Submit an explicit Yes or No at the exact response deadline and inspect the resulting response.
action_or_input.workflow_path: Attempt explicit Yes or No at the exact response deadline
action_or_input.blocked_reason: The exact-deadline precedence between user response and system default is unspecified.

source_id: BW-MMS-11 BW-MMS-11 Special Food — Rejected by Caretaker; CW-MMS-05 Special Food Request Lifecycle
purpose: Verify an explicit Caretaker rejection of a valid special-food request.
preconditions: The student is eligible to submit a special-food request.
The pending request remains Requested and has not reached its stipulated decision-period expiry.

steps: Student submits the valid special-food request.
Mess Caretaker rejects it before the decision period expires.

test_data.requested_date: At least one calendar day after submission.
test_data.decision: Caretaker rejects while the request is still within the stipulated decision period.

action_or_input.workflow_path: No Special Food Request -> Requested -> Rejected by Caretaker within the stipulated decision period

expected_result: The request progresses to Requested and then Rejected.
MMS triggers email notifications to the student for submission and decision.

source_id: BW-MMS-12 BW-MMS-12 Special Food — Default Rejected; CW-MMS-05 Special Food Request Lifecycle
purpose: Verify that an undecided request becomes Rejected by default when its stipulated decision period expires.
preconditions: A valid special-food request remains Requested without a Caretaker decision.

steps: Allow the stipulated decision period to expire without a decision.
Inspect the request status and student notification.

test_data.stipulated_decision_period: Exact value unavailable; Problem Statement identifies 12 hours as intended but says the policy value is institution-defined.

action_or_input.workflow_path: Requested -> institution-defined decision period expires undecided -> Rejected (Default)
action_or_input.blocked_reason: The exact configured decision period is necessary to set a deterministic test deadline; 12 hours is expressly only the intended value.

source_id: BW-MMS-13 BW-MMS-13 Special Food — Approved, Awaiting Fulfillment; CW-MMS-05 Special Food Request Lifecycle
purpose: Verify approval of a valid special-food request and its Awaiting Fulfillment outcome.
preconditions: The student is eligible to submit a special-food request.
The request remains Requested and has not reached its stipulated decision-period expiry.

steps: Student submits the valid request at the one-calendar-day lead-time boundary.
Mess Caretaker approves it while it is still within the stipulated decision period.

test_data.requested_date: Exactly one calendar day after submission.
test_data.decision: Caretaker approves while the request remains within the stipulated period.

action_or_input.workflow_path: No Special Food Request -> Requested -> Approved

expected_result: The request progresses to Requested and then Approved, awaiting fulfillment.
The approved request is chargeable and is added to the student's monthly bill.
MMS triggers email notifications for submission and decision.

source_id: BW-MMS-14 BW-MMS-14 Special Food — Served; CW-MMS-05 Special Food Request Lifecycle
purpose: Verify the post-approval fulfillment transition to Served.

steps: Mess Caretaker updates the approved request fulfillment status to Served.
action_or_input.workflow_path: Requested -> Approved -> Served

MMS triggers the applicable fulfillment-related student email notification.

source_id: BW-MMS-15 BW-MMS-15 Special Food — Cancelled; CW-MMS-05 Special Food Request Lifecycle
purpose: Verify the post-approval fulfillment transition to Cancelled.

steps: Mess Caretaker updates the approved request fulfillment status to Cancelled.

source_id: BW-MMS-16 BW-MMS-16 Monthly Billing — Generated to Published
purpose: Verify calendar-month bill generation followed by Caretaker review, finalization, and publication; verify a student can view the published bill.
preconditions: The calendar-month billing event is due.
Required billing inputs are available.
A student has a bill for the month.

steps: Allow the calendar-month billing event to generate bills.
Mess Caretaker reviews, finalizes, and publishes the generated bill.
Student views the published monthly bill and outstanding balance.

test_data.billing_inputs: Available served-day, approved special-meal/add-on, approved rebate, and daily-rate inputs.
test_data.bill_review: Caretaker reviews and finalizes generated bills before publication.

action_or_input.workflow_path: Monthly Bill Not Generated -> Monthly Bill Generated -> Monthly Bill Published

expected_result: A monthly bill is generated and then published only after Caretaker review and finalization.
The student can view the published bill and outstanding balance.
MMS triggers the monthly bill publication email notification.

source_id: BW-MMS-16 Monthly Billing — numeric bill calculation (Problem Statement)
purpose: Assert the exact numeric amount generated for a bill containing the specified charge and deduction types.
preconditions: A bill is generated for a calendar month.

steps: Generate a bill with served days, approved special meals/add-ons, and an approved rebate.

test_data.rates_and_amounts: No numeric rate or charge schedule is supplied.

action_or_input.workflow_path: Generate bill from served-day charges, approved special-meal/add-on charges, and approved rebate deductions
